settings.title: Finance Settings
settings.description: Choose which accounts the system should post to automatically when an invoice is issued or a payment is recorded. Issuing an invoice or recording a payment is blocked with a clear message until the accounts it needs are set here.

zatca.title: ZATCA Compliance (Phase 1 — Generation)
zatca.description: These identify your business on the QR code printed on tax invoices, per ZATCA's e-invoicing Generation Phase requirements.
zatca.vatNumberHint: Exactly 15 digits, as issued by ZATCA.
zatca.vatNumberInvalid: VAT registration number must be exactly 15 digits.
zatca.addressTitle: Seller Address (required for Phase 2 / Integration invoices)

empty.title: No accounts yet
empty.description: Create your first account to get started.

form.parentIdHint: Leave empty for a top-level account
form.cashFlowCategoryHint: Used only by the Cash Flow Statement to classify money movements. Safe to set or change anytime, even after transactions exist.
form.zakatCategoryHint: Used only by the Zakat Base Estimate. Leave unset for normal current items (cash, receivables, payables, revenue, expenses) — they're already reflected in the Equity figure the estimate starts from.

empty.title: No journal entries yet
empty.description: Create your first journal entry to get started.

detail.postConfirmMessage: Once posted, this entry can no longer be edited or deleted. To correct it later, you'll post a separate reversing entry. Continue?
detail.voidConfirmMessage: This marks the entry as void — it stays visible for audit purposes but is excluded from reports. Continue?

empty.title: No invoices yet
empty.description: Create your first invoice to get started.

form.noAcceptedQuotations: No accepted quotations are available to invoice yet.
form.editScopeHint: Only the due date and notes can be changed on a draft. To fix a line item or the customer, delete this draft and create a new one.
form.exchangeRateHint: Units of SAR per 1 unit of the selected currency, frozen at the moment you create this invoice.
form.paymentExchangeRateHint: The SAR exchange rate for {{currency}} today — used to calculate any realized FX gain or loss on this payment.

detail.zatcaQrHint: Scan to verify this invoice's seller, VAT number, timestamp, and totals — per ZATCA's e-invoicing Generation Phase requirements.
detail.issueConfirmMessage: This posts an accounting entry (debiting Accounts Receivable, crediting Revenue) and moves the invoice to 'Sent'. This cannot be undone. Continue?
detail.cancelConfirmMessage: This cancels the draft invoice. Continue?
detail.deleteConfirmMessage: This permanently removes the draft. This cannot be undone.
detail.foreignCurrencyNote: Amounts above are in {{currency}}. At the frozen rate of {{rate}}, the total is approximately {{sarEquivalent}} SAR.

empty.title: No vendors yet
empty.description: Create your first vendor to get started.

empty.title: No bills yet
empty.description: Create your first vendor bill to get started.

fields.projectHint: Optional — links this bill's cost to a project for budget tracking.

form.editScopeHint: Only the vendor reference, due date, and notes can be changed on a draft. To fix a line item or the vendor, delete this draft and create a new one.

detail.receiveConfirmMessage: This posts an accounting entry (debiting Expense, crediting Accounts Payable) and moves the bill to 'Received'. This cannot be undone. Continue?
detail.cancelConfirmMessage: This cancels the draft bill. Continue?
detail.deleteConfirmMessage: This permanently removes the draft. This cannot be undone.

reports.title: Financial Reports
reports.noData: No activity to show for this period.

trialBalance.title: Trial Balance
trialBalance.balanced: Balanced — total debits equal total credits.
trialBalance.notBalanced: Not balanced — this should never happen; please report this.

balanceSheet.title: Balance Sheet
balanceSheet.unclosedNetIncomeTitle: Net income not yet closed to equity
balanceSheet.unclosedNetIncomeHint: This system does not yet have a period-closing feature that moves net income into a Retained Earnings account. This figure is shown separately so the balance sheet remains meaningful in the meantime.
balanceSheet.balanced: Balanced — Assets equal Liabilities + Equity (including unclosed net income).
balanceSheet.notBalanced: Not balanced — this should never happen; please report this.

cashFlow.title: Cash Flow Statement
cashFlow.uncategorizedHint: These cash movements touch an account with no Cash Flow Category set yet. Assign one on the account (in Chart of Accounts) to move these into the right section.

zakat.title: Zakat Base Estimate
zakat.disclaimerTitle: This is an estimate, not a Zakat return.
zakat.disclaimerBody: It does not account for shareholder ownership structure (Saudi/GCC nationals owe Zakat; foreign shareholders owe income tax instead — this system has no ownership data at all) or the detailed adjustments required under ZATCA's Implementing Regulation for Zakat Collection. Treat this as a starting point for your Zakat advisor, never a number to file directly.
zakat.rateHint: Which rate applies (Hijri vs. Gregorian fiscal year) is a judgment call for your Zakat advisor — both are shown so nothing is decided silently.

aging.title: Customer Aging Report
aging.clickHint: Click a customer to open their full statement of account.

periods.title: Accounting Periods
periods.description: A locked period rejects any new posted entry dated inside it — manual journal entries, invoices being issued, bills being received, or payments being recorded.

empty.title: No periods yet
empty.description: Create your first accounting period to enable locking.

periods.lockConfirmMessage: Once locked, no new entry can be posted with a date inside this period — including invoices being issued, bills being received, and payments being recorded. This is meant to be difficult to undo casually. Continue?
periods.unlockConfirmMessage: This reopens the period to new entries — an exceptional, audit-worthy action. Only do this to correct a genuine mistake. Continue?

invoiceNotes.title: Credit / Debit Notes
invoiceNotes.empty: No credit or debit notes issued for this invoice.

type.creditHint: Reduces what the customer owes — for returns, pricing errors, or a post-invoice discount.
type.debitHint: Increases what the customer owes — for additional charges tied to this invoice.

customerPayments.title: Customer Payments
customerPayments.noOpenInvoices: This customer has no open (unpaid) invoices to allocate against.
customerPayments.overAllocatedWarning: You've allocated more than the amount received — reduce one or more allocations before continuing.

inventory.title: Inventory

form.inventoryAccountHint: The asset account this item's value sits in while in stock. Required before it can be purchased or sold.
form.cogsAccountHint: The expense account debited when this item is sold. Required before it can be sold.

adjust.title: Adjust Stock — {{name}}
adjust.currentStock: Currently {{qty}} {{unit}} on hand at an average cost of {{cost}} per unit.
adjust.offsetAccountHint: The other side of this adjustment's journal entry — e.g. a shrinkage expense account for a decrease, or an equity/found-stock account for an increase. Never guessed automatically.

empty.title: No inventory items yet
empty.description: Add your first item to start tracking stock and cost of goods sold.

inventory.selectItemHint: Link this line to a catalog item to automatically track stock and cost of goods sold.
